newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Oct retail/catering sales down 5-pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Oct retail/catering sales down 5-pct.

text.p: Turnover in Hungary's retail and catering sectors was five percent lower in real terms in the first ten months of 1996 than in the same period of 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Wednesday.
NOTE - Retail sales represent almost two-thirds of household consumption in Hungary.
Retail and catering turnover totalled 2,236 billion forints in January-October, up 18 percent in nominal terms from the corresponding period of 1995, the KSH said in a statement.
Retail sales, amounting to 2,074 billion forints in the January-October period, dropped almost five percent in real terms, while the turnover of catering units fell almost nine percent.
